notes: וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה divides by rule 21 and rule 40: הָיָה carries *became*, the resultative לְ is `unrepresented`, and the dative לוֹ is recast as the possessive *his*, its preposition `unrepresented` and its suffix taking the determiner.
*went in* keeps its particle with בּוֹא because the following אֶל writes the direction in the clause (rule 44).
